newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures end mostly higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures end mostly higher.

text.p: Nov 7 - Most U.S. stock index futures ended higher, with Dec S&Ps setting a contract high settlement amid good buying. Dec S&Ps set a contract high at 733.10 late in the day after U.S. bond futures rallied in the afternoon. Arbitrage buy programs were touched off when Dec traded at a 4.00-pt premium. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
